H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H8145: properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again
H4960: drink, by implication, drinking (the act); also (by implication) a banquet or (generally) feast
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H7596: a petition; by implication, a loan
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H4672: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
H2580: graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty)
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H2895: to be (transitively, do or make) good (or well) in the widest sense
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H4376: to sell, literally (as merchandise, a daughter in marriage, into slavery), or figuratively (to surrender)
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H8198: a female slave (as a member of the household)
H2790: to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness)
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H6862: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble ; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
H7737: properly, to level, i.e. equalize; figuratively, to resemble; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.)
H325: Achashverosh (i.e. Ahasuerus or Artaxerxes, but in this case Xerxes), the title (rather than name) of a Persian king
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H4390: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything

H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H2534: heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H5975: to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
H1245: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H3615: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H4296: a bed (as extended) forsleeping or eating; by analogy, a sofa, litter or bier
H3533: to tread down; hence, negatively, to disregard; positively, to conquer, subjugate, violate
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H2645: to cover; by implication, to veil, to encase, protect
H2726: Charbona or Charbonah, a eunuch of Xerxes
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H5631: a eunuch; by implication, valet (especially of the female apartments), and thus, a minister of state
H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H520: properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance)
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H7918: to weave (i.e. lay) a trap; figuratively, (through the idea of secreting) to allay (passions; physically, abate a flood)
